_comment: AUTHORED. A two-currency account, and the only scenario with more than one currency. The shape it pins is design 7.0: one ring per currency, per-currency card figures, no report-level money figure. Three things make it discriminating rather than merely multi-key. (1) primary_currency is USD while LKR is the LARGER spend, so the served 4.2 order (USD first) is neither alphabetical (LKR first) nor size-ranked (LKR first) — a regression to either is visible. (2) Anthropic holds money in BOTH currencies, so a card's header lines exercise the per-currency 7.2 shape rather than a single figure. (3) OpenAI holds LKR only, so the LKR ring has two services and its percentages are a real share split (73.6/26.4) instead of the degenerate 100% a one-service ring gives every denominator. Against the frozen clock 2026-04-15T12:00:00Z the whole month is 2026-04-01..2026-04-15. No balance is seeded: balances are sequenced for design 11 step 5 and the corpus carries no balance surface.
name: two-currency
